# PG002 — TypeAdapter used as a field annotation

## Cause

A `TypeAdapter` appears as a field annotation inside a Pydantic model body. A
`TypeAdapter` is a tool for validating a type, not a field type — it "should not
be used as a type annotation for specifying fields of a BaseModel"
(`pydantic/concepts/type-adapter.md:72-75`).

## Fix

Use `RootModel` for a reusable, named, subclassable root type; or annotate the
field with the underlying type directly.

```python
# Before — PG002
class Config(BaseModel):
    ids: TypeAdapter[list[int]]


# After — no violation
class Ids(RootModel[list[int]]):
    pass


class Config(BaseModel):
    ids: Ids
```

## Suppression

Suppress with `# noqa: PG002` on the annotation line.
